label: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 is a prerelease currently tagged next in npm, while the source commit/package integrity relationship remains unverified.
Five dependency install scripts were skipped, leaving headless sandbox backend needs and startup latency unverified.
Headless has no listener and exits after one run; telemetry can be disabled, while session-log uploads and actual route cost need explicit policy or measurement.

The cli-dsh packet should bind exact version/provider routes, headless JSON/stdin, timeout and sandbox checks, telemetry-off policy, explicit MCP, and secret handling; multiple items remain UNKNOWN pending an authorized probe.
A six-phase required plan from contract pin through runtime, executor, guards, routing and release gates isolates optional plugin parity to a later seventh phase.
